# Third party and source notices

The OSLC integration adapts the local INCOSE Assessment Script's launcher, message validation, delegated-token handoff, context, and native-server patterns. The copied Requirements-to-Hardware REST helper retains its source header. File hashes and origins are recorded in `source-provenance.json`. The INCOSE source package declares a proprietary license; this project does not relicense that code or establish permission for redistribution outside its authorized owner/customer use.

Three.js 0.180.0 is supplied under MIT; its license is included at `frontend/vendor/three/LICENSE`. Vendored ES module imports are rewritten to relative paths so the viewer needs no CDN/import-map script. The included fflate module retains its upstream notices. Archive integrity and resulting file hashes are recorded in `vendor-lock.json`.

The optional STEP conversion dependency is occt-import-js 0.0.23 (LGPL-2.1), with Open CASCADE Technology in its WebAssembly build. Its license is included at `frontend/vendor/occt/LICENSE.md`. It is kept as a separate, replaceable component. Upstream source and build information: https://github.com/kovacsv/occt-import-js/tree/0.0.23 ; npm archive: https://registry.npmjs.org/occt-import-js/-/occt-import-js-0.0.23.tgz . Check the upstream release/tag and its pinned OCCT submodule when preparing corresponding source for redistribution; retain LGPL/OCCT notices and the applicable exception text. An npm runtime archive is not a substitute for complete corresponding source. Distribution outside this workspace requires supplying the applicable source/relinking materials or otherwise satisfying those licenses. The static-only release omits this optional converter.

Python dependencies are requests (Apache-2.0) and Pillow (HPND), with their transitive dependencies and notices retained in their wheel distributions. Node.js is an optional separately installed runtime. Playwright is a development-only browser testing dependency and is excluded from release packages.
